(hereinafter referred to the “Council”), which shall be vested
with the administration and management of the affairs of the
Institute.

President,  the  immediate  Past  president  in  the  case  of  a
successive Council, the Secretary, the Treasurer, the Assistant
Secretary, the Assistant Treasurer and such other number of
members, not less than two and not more than eight, elected
or  appointed in accordance with the rules of the Institute.
